projects.name: AI Tray
projects.tagline: Desktop AI helpers that stay out of the way
projects.description: AI Tray provides lightweight desktop assistants for everyday workflows — summarization, drafting, and quick actions — with a focus on privacy-conscious local and remote model options.

showcase.problem: Desktop AI tools are often heavyweight or browser-bound, interrupting focus when you only need a quick summary or draft.
showcase.solution: A lightweight tray companion that keeps common AI actions one gesture away while respecting local and remote model choices.

features.title: Quick actions
features.description: Summarize, draft, and transform text without leaving your flow.

features.title: Privacy-conscious options
features.description: Prefer local models when possible; remote providers remain optional.

demo.note: Tray demo build is not available on the public showcase yet.

showcase.contributing: Ideas for tray actions and model adapters are welcome via issues.

projects.name: Document Platform
projects.tagline: Flutter-native document editing you can embed
projects.description: Document Platform is an independent Flutter document-editing stack: schema-driven model, commands, hybrid rendering, clipboard/HTML interchange, plugins, and templates — split into focused Melos packages hosts can compose without forking a monolith.

showcase.problem: Enterprise Flutter apps need structured rich documents, selection/IME, toolbar, and clipboard fidelity — without bolting those concerns onto an editor that was not designed for embedding.
showcase.solution: A Melos package monorepo with clear dependency direction toward document_core: model, session, presentation, UI, interchange, plugins, and theming that hosts compose.

features.title: Schema-driven document model
features.description: Hierarchical nodes, attributions, and transactional mutations in document_core.

features.title: Editor session & commands
features.description: Selection, IME, inverse undo/redo, and command pipeline in document_editor.

features.title: Interchange fidelity
features.description: Clipboard pipeline plus HTML and Markdown packages for host integration.

features.title: Embeddable examples
features.description: example_basic, example_embed, example_enterprise, and email_template_editor showcase hosts.

demo.note: Run examples/example_basic locally (Editor Playground). Interactive web embed for the public portal is planned.

media.caption: Hosts compose packages; dependencies point inward toward document_core

showcase.architecture: Dependency direction is inward toward document_core. Layers: model → session → presentation → UI → interchange → plugins/theme. Cycles require an ADR. See docs/architecture/ in the Document Platform repository.

architectureDiagram.caption: Model, session, rendering, widgets, interchange, plugins

platformSupport.notes: Supported for portal and host embeds

showcase.installation: Clone https://github.com/roshandroids/Document_Platform, run dart pub get at the workspace root, then: cd examples/example_basic && flutter run -d macos

changelog.notes: Directional architecture freeze closeout; package suite at 0.1.0 with high coverage gates.

showcase.contributing: See CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/process/ in the Document Platform repository. Prefer package-level changes with ADRs when dependency direction is affected.

projects.name: Localization Analyzer
projects.tagline: Find missing and unused localization keys
projects.description: Localization Analyzer scans Flutter ARB and localization usage to surface missing keys, unused entries, and consistency issues across locales before they reach production.

showcase.problem: Localization drift—missing keys, unused entries, and locale inconsistencies—often appears only after QA or production releases.
showcase.solution: A desktop analyzer that scans ARB files and Dart usage to report gaps early in the development loop.

features.title: Missing key detection
features.description: Compare usage against ARB definitions across locales.

features.title: Unused entry reports
features.description: Find keys that no longer appear in code.

demo.note: CLI/desktop demo packaging is not published yet.

showcase.installation: Install via the upcoming desktop package or run from source with Flutter on macOS, Linux, or Windows.
showcase.contributing: Report false positives and locale edge cases via GitHub issues.
